m: Marinade: grate the apple, garlic and ginger and mix with the soy, brown sugar, sesame oil and sliced spring onion. Coat the ribs and marinate at least 1 hour, ideally overnight.
Get a BBQ, grill pan or heavy pan very hot. Cook the ribs in a single layer, 2 minutes a side, until caramelised and charred at the edges.
Rest 2 minutes, then cut between the bones into bite-size pieces with scissors.
Ssamjang-style sauce: gochujang loosened with a little sesame oil and water.
Serve with rice, kimchi, lettuce leaves for wrapping, sauce and sesame seeds.
l: Ribs over rice, kimchi on the side. Reheat in a hot pan to bring back the char.
g: Tamari instead of soy, sriracha instead of gochujang, and marinate the GF ribs separately. Check the kimchi.
